registration.title: Squad strength as an extra input to club forecasts
registration.what: A club-neutral measure of squad strength added to forecasts of a club's next 5, 10 and 20 matches.
registration.why: A squad can change faster than results show, after a transfer window for instance.
registration.how: Squad strength is added on top of current rank, long-term rank and the squad's own club history, and judged on goal difference, points and opponent-adjusted goal difference.
registration.hypothesis: Squad strength carries forward information the club ranks do not.
registration.success_criteria: At least 1% better squared error beyond club-history controls, on goal difference, points and adjusted goal difference, and consistent across periods.

events.label: Opponent-adjusted goal difference over the next 10 matches, share of squared error
events.meaningful: No. Raw goal difference and points clear 1% at some horizons, but the adjusted measure stays under 1%, is uncertain at 20 matches and changes sign between periods.

events.reason: The pre-set criterion needed adjusted goal difference too, and it failed. Squad strength is not fed into ranks or forecasts.
